Blocked by unavailable deterministic success path for retry/resend behavior on the authenticated surface.
Blocked because the available error fixture validates delivery-log load failure, not retry mutation failure; no row-level retry request could be triggered to observe error-toast behavior.

frictions.description: The authenticated surface had only a single sent row in the 7d dataset, so the assigned assertions could not be exercised against real failed/bounced rows.
The documented forced-error trigger exposed a standalone Retry button inside an error alert rather than a row-level retry flow, preventing confirmation-dialog and mutation testing.
agent-browser network tracking did not capture requests for this session even after navigation and refresh actions
frictions.resolution: Used URL changes, rendered last-updated text, and screenshots as deterministic evidence instead
